notes.title: “Wukong's Pool” v1.12 game update
notes.notes:
This update optimizes some operations:

Slightly increase the distance between cards so that they can be fully displayed even when the mouse is not hovering them.
Add "Camera Move" to the settings to adjust the amplitude of the camera moving with the mouse.
Add "Show Tutorial" and "Quick Restart" functions to the in-game menu.

If you have any suggestions, you can give us feedback via ruizstudiogo@gmail.com.

notes.title: “Wukong's Pool” v1.11 game update
notes.notes:
This update optimizes some operations:

 Make the poker cards in the hand more opaque when the mouse is hovered to prevent blocking key information on the table.
 Add a slight rotation hotkey. After pressing the left mouse button, you can use the "1/2" to slightly rotate left/right.
 Add a "screen shake" option in the settings.
 The in-game dashboard now shows the current score (and formula).

Thanks to the player coolcato for his valuable feedback!
If you have any suggestions, feel free to give us feedback via ruizstudiogo@gmail.com.

notes.title: “Wukong's Pool” v1.1 game update
notes.notes:
After the game was released, we received a lot of feedback from players. During this period, we made the following optimizations to the gameplay.

Game Logic Adjustment
Now "Wukong's Pool" has adjusted the "single card mode" and "multi-card mode" to "normal mode" and "crazy mode", and the game logic is more unified:

After the start, the player draws 5 cards per round, and each completed card will gain a skill upgrade.
If no card is completed in one stroke, 1 health will be deducted.
In the crazy mode, the logic is the same as the normal mode, but the card difficulty will be higher, and random cards will be "cursed".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044611/8c064e5d5b2d496cd22fb75a0f88ea584cd2db56.gif
Difficulty Adjustment
In the previous version, the difficulty gradient of the 54 cards was too steep, causing players to feel very frustrated when playing. We have made the following adjustments:

Greatly reduce the overall difficulty of the cards.
Add a cardcurse mechanism to make the game more random in "crazy mode" but not too difficult.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044611/91edcf5f4edced447112b703d8934ec1a85e57c0.gif
Content Richness
This update also brings more content, including:

10 card curses.
7 new skills, including new active skills that can interact with hand cards.


If you encounter any problems during the game, feel free to report to us at ruizstudiogo@gmail.com.
